questions.text:
Consider the following: Statement: Good voice is a natural gift but one has to keep practising to improve and well in the field of music. 

Conclusions: 

I. Natural gifts need nurturing and care. 
II. Even though one's voice is not good, one can keep practising. 

Which one of the following is correct, in respect of the above statement and conclusions?
questions.answer: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows from the statement.
